∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (events : List (Option Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow)),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.eventScanFrom s events =
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom s (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.acceptedProjection events)

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow)
  (arbitraryPriorFlag : Bool),
  (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.executeInstructions { state := s, row := row, mismatchFlag := arbitraryPriorFlag }
        Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.runGateProgram).state =
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row

∀ (table : List (String × String)) (key : String),
  Sonification.Mat008.lookup table key ≠ none → key ∈ List.map Prod.fst table

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch s row = true ↔
    ∃ oldCampaign, s.owners row.originalRun = some oldCampaign ∧ oldCampaign ≠ row.campaign

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch s row =
      Sonification.Mat008.differentOwner m (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.projectRow row)

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  s.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = false →
    ((Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true ↔
      Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch s row = true)

(Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.empty
          [{ campaign := "A", originalRun := "RUN" }, { campaign := "B", originalRun := "RUN" },
            { campaign := "B", originalRun := "OTHER" }]).reasons
      Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
    true ∧
  (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.empty
          [{ campaign := "A", originalRun := "RUN_A" }, { campaign := "B", originalRun := "RUN_B" }]).reasons
      Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
    false

let s := { owners := fun x => none, reasons := fun x => true };
Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch s { campaign := "CAMPAIGN", originalRun := "RUN" } = false ∧
  (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s { campaign := "CAMPAIGN", originalRun := "RUN" }).reasons
      Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
    true
Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.empty Sonification.Mat008.initial

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m → Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.FiniteSupport s.owners

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m → ∀ (key : String), s.owners key = Sonification.Mat008.lookup m.owner key

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).owners row.originalRun = some row.campaign

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnersRelated (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).owners
      (Sonification.Mat008.step m (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.projectRow row)).owner

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    ((Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true ↔
      (Sonification.Mat008.step m (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.projectRow row)).conflict = true)

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  s.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true →
    (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  s.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true →
    (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom s rows).reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason = true

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (events : List (Option Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow)),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.eventScanFrom s events)
      (Sonification.Mat008.scanFrom m
        (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.project (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.acceptedProjection events)))

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom s rows)
      (Sonification.Mat008.scanFrom m (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.project rows))

∀ (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow) (a b : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  a ∈ rows →
    b ∈ rows →
      a.originalRun = b.originalRun →
        a.campaign ≠ b.campaign →
          (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyScanFrom Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.empty rows).reasons
              Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
            true

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow) (reason : String),
  reason ≠ Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason →
    (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).reasons reason = s.reasons reason

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row).reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
    (s.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason || Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch s row)

∀ (before after : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related before m →
    (∀ (key : String), after.owners key = before.owners key) →
      after.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason =
          before.reasons Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason →
        Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related after m

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.PyState) (m : Sonification.Mat008.State)
  (row : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.AcceptedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related s m →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.Related (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.pyStep s row)
      (Sonification.Mat008.step m (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.projectRow row))

∀ (owners : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnerMap) (key value query : String),
  query ≠ key → Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.write owners key value query = owners query

∀ (owners : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnerMap) (table : List (String × String)) (key value : String),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnersRelated owners table →
    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnersRelated (Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.write owners key value)
      ((key, value) :: table)

∀ (owners : Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.OwnerMap) (key value : String),
  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.write owners key value key = some value
